name: shouldAutofillBillingAddressFromProfile
description: The billing address is prefilled from the profile saved at registration
descriptionHtml: The billing address is prefilled from the profile saved at registration

steps.name: Set up the driver and the Allure listener

testStage.description: The billing address is prefilled from the profile saved at registration

steps.name: Create a user through the API ang sign in
Create the user user1793537613341@example.com through the API
Submit the login form with email user1793537613341@example.com
Fill in the login form for user1793537613341@example.com
Verify the account page is opened
Add product #0 from the Hand Tools category to the cart
Open product 'Claw Hammer with Shock Reduction Grip'

parameters.name: title
parameters.value: Claw Hammer with Shock Reduction Grip

steps.name: Add the product to the cart
Verify the 'added to cart' notification is shown
Continue as the signed in user
Verify the billing address is prefilled from the profile of user1793537613341@example.com
